note: Heartside's channel specialists (Krish, 2026-10-30). The seven channel tasks are defined once in krishanraja/ai-harness contract/channel-tasks.md; each specialist says what each task accomplishes for Heartside on its channels, and the job that runs it. No new scheduler: every job is already in automations.json. Platforms: Instagram, TikTok and Facebook only (Krish, 2026-10-29).

crew.name: Meta (Instagram + Facebook, paired)
crew.signal: Sends per reach, then tracked link taps and organic orders

platform-truth.accomplishes: Official Instagram and Facebook guidance on Reels, sends, Story link stickers and shopping tags, read against Heartside's own sends per reach

profile-audit.accomplishes: The bio, pinned Reels, tracked bio link and Page button tell a US dog owner in one look that their dog can send a gift, and take them to it

idea-bank.accomplishes: Gift moments by buyer (partner, mom, dad, friend) and occasion, where a dog owner sees their own dog telling the person it loves something, each ending on the real product

reel-script.accomplishes: Five muted-first hooks for a gift buyer; the payoff is the live store's real render labeled Example, never an AI-drawn product or customer, judged on sends per reach and tracked taps

caption-set.accomplishes: Five captions: Instagram puts the gift search phrase in the first line, Facebook invites the 30 to 49 gift buyer's own dog story, both in the dog's voice with no exclamation marks

trend-scan.accomplishes: Pet and gifting trends on Instagram and Facebook that can carry the real design unchanged, aimed at the Black Friday and 10 December pushes

channel-plan.accomplishes: Thirty days of concepts at up to 5 posts a day per platform under concept approval, worked back from the organic sales ladder and the US gifting calendar

crew.name: TikTok
crew.signal: Shares and saves per view, then profile visits to heartside.io

platform-truth.accomplishes: Official TikTok guidance on search, captions and links for an account under 1,000 followers, with no clickable link yet

profile-audit.accomplishes: The bio says heartside.io until the link unlocks at 1,000 followers, and the profile shows what the gift is before anyone taps

idea-bank.accomplishes: The phrases dog owners type into TikTok search for gifts, each answered by a post that shows the real product made from a dog's photo

reel-script.accomplishes: Five on-screen hooks of 3 to 7 words, judged on shares and saves per view, ending on the real render, never AI customers holding it

caption-set.accomplishes: Five captions leading with the search phrase and 2 to 5 specific hashtags, promising no link the account cannot show yet

trend-scan.accomplishes: Sounds and formats in pet TikTok that can carry the real design unchanged, adapted without copying the creator

channel-plan.accomplishes: Thirty days judged on profile visits to heartside.io, with low expectations until the audience country reads US
